BDI.note: Nothing on a national ID system; the biometric capture described is for tax registration.
The e-KORI platform covers registration, not payment or filing of taxes.

facts.fact: Digital Business Africa reports that the Office burundais des Recettes put its e-KORI platform live on 4 August 2026, so taxpayer registration applications are filed online and registration certificates issued by e-mail, with biometric capture for individuals.
